mapper.select: /** getBuildingMemberLoginIdListBySerial **/ SELECT usr.login_id FROM user_building ub INNER JOIN device dev ON dev.building_id = ub.id INNER JOIN user_building_member ubm ON ub.id = ubm.building_id INNER JOIN `user` usr ON ubm.user_id = usr.id WHERE dev.serial = #{serial} AND dev.linked_yn = 'Y'
